definition: [ מִשְׁאֶ֑רָת ] noun feminine a household vessel , AV (Exodus), RV kneading-trough ; vessel in which was dough before it was leavened ( Exod 12:34 ) (hence usually derived from שְׂאֹר leaven (with שׂ — by error? — for שׂ ), but this not certain; compare מַשְׂרֵת above); — only suffix מִשְׁאַרְתֶּ֑ךָ Deut 28:5 ; Deut 28:17 (both + טַנְאֲךָ ); plural suffix מִשְׁאֲרוֺתֶיךָ , Exod 7:28 ( J ; + תַּנּוּרֶיךָ ), מִשְׁאֲרֹתָם Exod 12:34 ( E ). מְשֻׁבָה see מְשׁוּבָה . מִשְׁבְּצוֺת see שׁבץ מַשְׂבֵּר , [ מִשְׁבָּר ] see שׁבר . [ מִשְׁבָּת ] see שׁבת . מִשְׁגֶּה see שׁגה .

[מִשְׁאֶ֑רָת] noun feminine a household vessel, AV(Exodus), RV kneading-trough; vessel in which was dough before it was leavened (Exod 12:34) (hence usually derived from שְׂאֹר leaven (with שׂ — by error? — for שׂ), but this not certain; compare מַשְׂרֵת above); — only suffix מִשְׁאַרְתֶּ֑ךָ Deut 28:5; Deut 28:17 (both + טַנְאֲךָ); plural suffix מִשְׁאֲרוֺתֶיךָ, Exod 7:28 (J; + תַּנּוּרֶיךָ), מִשְׁאֲרֹתָם Exod 12:34 (E).

מְשֻׁבָה see מְשׁוּבָה. מִשְׁבְּצוֺת see שׁבץ

מַשְׂבֵּר, [מִשְׁבָּר] see שׁבר.

[מִשְׁבָּת] see שׁבת. מִשְׁגֶּה see שׁגה.
